_编辑说明: 这是大厅 NPC 玛雅的唯一台词文件。修改中文请改 *_zh 或 zh，修改英文请改 *_en 或 en。
states：任务期大厅气泡；ambient_lines：短气泡；postgraduate：毕业后工作、观测、事件、打断、茶歇和私人记忆；room_text：玛雅工作台与休息面板文字。
可以增加或删减 lines_en / lines_zh 数组中的句子，但请保留 JSON 标点、字段名以及 {target}、{instrument}、{night} 等占位符。
duration_min / duration_max 是基础秒数，游戏运行时统一乘以 10；不必手动再乘。

lines_en: There you are, little stargazer~
lines_zh: 你终于来啦，小观测员~

lines_en: This way—stay close to your senior~
lines_zh: 这边呀，跟紧学姐~

lines_en: Hey, over here~
lines_zh: 喂，这边这边~

lines_en: Wrong way, stargazer! Over here~
lines_zh: 走反啦，小观测员！这边~

lines_en: No rush, I'll wait for you
lines_zh: 不急，我等你呀

lines_en: Right ahead—see it?
lines_zh: 就前面，看到没？

lines_en: We're here—this is the spot~
lines_zh: 到啦，就是这儿~

lines_en: Hehe, look here!
lines_zh: 哎嘿，看这里！

lines_en: Come a tiny bit closer
lines_zh: 再靠近一点点呀

lines_en: Yes, right here!
lines_zh: 对，就是这里！

lines_en: Whoa, you beat me here!
lines_zh: 哇，你比我还快！

lines_en: Stargazer, are you spacing out?
lines_zh: 小观测员在发呆吗？

lines_en: Come on, let's see what tonight has for us~
lines_zh: 走，看看今晚折腾什么~

lines_en: New task—target first!
lines_zh: 新任务来啦，先看目标！

lines_en: Remember the target before grabbing gear
lines_zh: 先记目标，别急着拿设备

lines_en: Good—target remembered. Let's go~
lines_zh: 好，目标记住了就出发~

lines_en: Which part was unclear? We'll read it together
lines_zh: 哪里没看懂？我陪你再看

lines_en: All the parts are over here~
lines_zh: 零件都在这边，跟我来~

lines_en: Here, pick a set that feels right
lines_zh: 来，挑一套顺手的呀

lines_en: Start with these—ignore the scary full cabinet~
lines_zh: 先看这些，别被一柜子吓到~

lines_en: Wait, one is missing. I'll help you look
lines_zh: 等等，还少一个，我陪你找

lines_en: This set is heavy—hold it steady
lines_zh: 这套可不轻，拿稳啦

lines_en: New gear! To the workbench~
lines_zh: 新设备！走，去工作台~

lines_en: Come on, I cleared a spot for you
lines_zh: 快来快来，我都腾好位置啦

lines_en: Come on. The conditions are good tonight~
lines_zh: 走呀，今晚条件不错，别错过啦~

lines_en: Let's head out and check tonight's sky~
lines_zh: 走，去外面看看今晚的天~

lines_en: Here we are—don't jump to high power yet
lines_zh: 就是这里，先别急着上高倍

lines_en: We're here—check the weather before going out
lines_zh: 到啦，出去前先看一眼天气

lines_en: You take the controls; I'll stay nearby~
lines_zh: 你来控，我在旁边看着~

lines_en: Come on, let's log what you just saw
lines_zh: 走，把刚才看到的记下来

lines_en: Write here—start with what you're sure of
lines_zh: 写这里，先记你最确定的

lines_en: Found the page from just now—here~
lines_zh: 找到刚才那页啦，给你~

lines_en: Filed—now we can compare it next time
lines_zh: 收好啦，下次还能拿来对照

lines_en: Hehe, another page in the logbook!
lines_zh: 哎嘿，日志里又多一页！

lines_en: These are all yours—not bad, huh~
lines_zh: 这些都是你留下的，挺厉害嘛~

lines_en: All right, closed! What's next?
lines_zh: 好，合上啦！下一项？

lines_en: New terminal unlocked—let's see it!
lines_zh: 新终端解锁啦，过去看看！

lines_en: Look—the remote link is live!
lines_zh: 快看，远程信号接上了！

lines_en: Choose a target before moving the mirrors
lines_zh: 先挑目标，别急着乱转镜面

lines_en: Wait! We can't turn it that way
lines_zh: 等等！这个方向不能转

lines_en: Temperature is stable—we can continue
lines_zh: 温度稳住啦，可以继续

lines_en: Lock it first—don't let the target drift away
lines_zh: 先锁住它，别让目标溜掉

remote_guide_near.status_en: The guide lock is nearly ready
lines_en: Easy—guiding is almost locked
lines_zh: 别动别动，马上锁住啦

lines_en: Shh, let the detector gather the light
lines_zh: 嘘，让探测器慢慢收光

lines_en: Data's back! Don't close it yet~
lines_zh: 数据回来啦！先别关~

lines_en: These are false colors—pick a channel first
lines_zh: 这些是假彩色，先挑通道呀

remote_composite.status_zh: 隐藏的结构显现出来了
lines_en: Look! The hidden structure is showing
lines_zh: 看！藏着的结构出来啦

lines_en: Got it? No pretending if you don't~
lines_zh: 会了没？不会也不许装会哦~

lines_en: The mount is steady and every lock is set
lines_zh: 支架很稳，锁扣也都到位啦

lines_en: The detail really came through—log it!
lines_zh: 这次细节真出来了，快记！

lines_en: We really caught the signal—save it first~
lines_zh: 真的收到信号了！先存下来~

lines_en: I may really be out of lessons… your turn to lead me?
lines_zh: 好像真没什么能教你了……换你带我？

lines_en: Little stargazer, come with me~
lines_zh: 小观测员，跟我来一下~

telescope_ownership.status_zh: 这些望远镜现在属于你
lines_en: These scopes are yours to look after now
lines_zh: 以后这些镜子也归你照看啦

lines_en: Congratulations—no, I should call you Observer now!
lines_zh: 恭喜呀——不对，该叫你观测员了！

free_mode.status_en: The observatory is yours to explore
lines_en: From now on, choose whatever you want to see~
lines_zh: 以后想看什么，就自己挑呀~

lines_en: What should we see tonight? Your call~
lines_zh: 今晚想看什么？我听你的~

lines_en: You take it—I saved the spot for you
lines_zh: 你来控吧，我给你留着位置呢

lines_en: You're here—want to look together?
lines_zh: 来都来了，一起看会儿？

lines_en: Go on—see you in a bit~
lines_zh: 去忙吧，待会儿见~

lines_en: You're finally back, little stargazer~
lines_zh: 你终于回来啦，小观测员~

lines_en: The sky's being nice to us tonight~
lines_zh: 今晚的天挺给面子嘛~

lines_en: Yep, this is the target
lines_zh: 嗯，就是这个目标

lines_en: Huh… which piece is still missing?
lines_zh: 奇怪，还少哪一件来着？

lines_en: This set is heavy… where did I put my tool?
lines_zh: 这套真沉，我工具又放哪了？

lines_en: What do you want to see tonight?
lines_zh: 今晚想看什么呀？

lines_en: Hehe, these are all your records
lines_zh: 哎嘿，这些可都是你的记录

lines_en: The link is live—don't keep it waiting
lines_zh: 信号接上啦，别让它等太久

lines_en: What should we see tonight… any ideas?
lines_zh: 今晚看什么好呢……你有主意吗？

lines_en: Watch the terminator. Crater shadows are clearest there
The Moon is bright. Lower the glare before chasing detail~
lines_zh: 看明暗交界线，那一带的环形山阴影最清楚
月亮太亮时，先把亮度压下来再找细节~

lines_en: The two main bands are steady; now find the thin one between
That tiny point beside it is a moon—don't miss it
lines_zh: 两条主云带很稳，再找中间那根细线
旁边那颗小亮点是卫星，别漏掉呀

lines_en: Mars really is that small; patience beats forcing more power
Wait for steadier air. The dark marking may show briefly
lines_zh: 火星就这么小，耐心比硬加倍率管用
等视野稳定一点，暗斑可能只清楚几秒

lines_en: Vega should be a blue-white point; check its fringe
Don't make a star a disk; the smallest point is sharpest
lines_zh: 织女星该是干净的蓝白点，顺便看看彩边
别把恒星拧成小圆饼，最小才是合焦

lines_en: Sirius is so bright that poor seeing is easy to notice
Those colors come from our air, not from the star
lines_zh: 天狼星很亮，视宁度一差就会闪得特别厉害
那些跳动的颜色是空气，不是它在变色哦

lines_en: Betelgeuse is warm orange—compare it with a blue-white star
It varies, yes, but not once every minute
lines_zh: 参宿四暖橙暖橙的，和蓝白星比一下呀
它会变亮变暗，可没快到一分钟一次哦

lines_en: Use averted vision. The faint glow is easier to notice
A nebula has no hard edge, so do not force an outline
lines_zh: 用余光看，旁边那层淡光会明显一点
星云边缘很淡，别硬找一条清楚的轮廓

lines_en: It's wider than our view; catch the bright core first
A bright background hides the outer glow. It is not focus
lines_zh: 它比视野宽多啦，今晚先抓住明亮核心
背景太亮会淹掉外层辉光，不是对焦的问题

lines_en: The seeing is steady tonight. Let's make good use of it~
Even the faint stars are barely flickering
Nights like this make every job feel easier
lines_zh: 今晚视宁度很稳，别浪费啦~
连暗一点的星都没怎么闪
这种夜晚，干活都顺手好多

lines_en: Thin cloud is being annoying again; let it pass
That clear patch in the west is drifting our way
Wait. Focus is fine; that is just the cloud passing
lines_zh: 薄云又来捣乱啦，等它走就好
西边那块晴空正慢慢挪过来
等等，对焦没问题，只是云刚好挡住了

lines_en: The sky is clear, but the seeing keeps changing
Use lower power tonight. Going higher may only blur it
Wait for one quiet moment before judging
lines_zh: 天是晴的，不过视宁度一直在变
今晚先用低一点的倍率，太高反而更糊
等画面安静一下，再下判断呀

lines_en: The sky is lovely and my hands are freezing… fair trade
Let the tube cool fully before we start calibrating
The dome sounds especially loud on a cold night
lines_zh: 天空很漂亮，手也很冷……算公平吧
先让镜筒凉透，再开始校准呀
天气一冷，穹顶转动的声音都更明显了

night_events.extra_assembly_step_en: Fit the dew strap and route its cable
night_events.extra_assembly_step_zh: 安装除露带并整理供电线
lines_en: Humidity's rising; we're not fogging up halfway
Touch the metal, not the glass—the tube is already dewing
lines_zh: 湿度又往上爬啦，我可不想看一半起雾
摸金属，别碰玻璃呀，镜筒已经挂露水了

lines_en: I found my first logbook. Wow, my writing was messy
I could barely see the image, but I sounded so certain
lines_zh: 翻到我最早的日志了……这字也太潦草啦
那时候图都看不清，记录倒写得特别肯定

colleague_lines_en: Yep. You may read it, but no laughing at my old handwriting~
First year: neat dates, bad sketches, and lots of mistakes
colleague_lines_zh: 是呀，可以看，但不许笑我那时候的字~
一年级写的：日期很认真，草图很糟，错得也多
familiar_lines_en: Go ahead. I misidentified targets all the time back then
I called glare a detail here. I kept it as a reminder
familiar_lines_zh: 给你看吧，我那时候也经常认错目标
这页把眩光当成细节了，我到现在还留着
trusted_lines_en: Look at the margin. I wrote that I wanted a shift partner
Keep this quiet; your senior wasn't always so composed
trusted_lines_zh: 你看页角，我那时写过‘希望有人一起值夜’
替我保密呀，学姐也不是一直这么稳的

night_events.extra_assembly_step_en: Re-zero the finder on a reference star
night_events.extra_assembly_step_zh: 用基准星重新标定寻星镜
lines_en: The finder drifted again; we'll zero it on a reference star
Trust the reference star more than those little marks
lines_zh: 寻星镜又偏啦，今晚抓颗基准星归零
信基准星，别太信那几根刻线哦

lines_en: Another one! No instrument needed for that~
Bright streak overhead? Look up—the log can wait
lines_zh: 又一颗！这个可不需要任何仪器~
穹顶有亮线就先抬头，记录晚一秒没关系

lines_en: The night is still young, stargazer~
We still have a long stretch of darkness ahead
lines_zh: 夜还早呢，小观测员~
前面还有好长一段黑夜呀

lines_en: After midnight, even our footsteps sound loud in here
The late shift has started. Tell me if you get sleepy
lines_zh: 过了半夜，连脚步声都听得特别清楚
后半夜开始啦，困了就告诉我

lines_en: There's enough darkness left for one more~
The east will brighten soon—one last round?
lines_zh: 还剩一点黑夜，够我们再看一个~
东边快亮啦，最后一轮？

excellent_lines_en: That view was beautifully steady! You write the first line
I saw the detail you caught too!
Hold onto that view—come on, let's log it now~
excellent_lines_zh: 刚才稳得真漂亮！第一行你来写
你抓到的细节，我也看见了！
这张先别忘，走，马上记下来~
good_lines_en: Nice! Which detail did you notice first?
This one's worth keeping—come compare notes~
Not perfect, but useful. I like records like that
good_lines_zh: 不错呀，你最先看见的是哪个细节？
这次值得留，来和我对笔记~
不算完美，但很有用，我喜欢这种记录
fair_lines_en: Wait—don't blame the scope. Let's log the air first
The seeing was poor. That does not mean you did it wrong
This result still helps us narrow down the cause
fair_lines_zh: 等等，先别怪望远镜，我们先记今晚的空气
今晚视宁度不好，不是你哪里做错了呀
这个结果也有用，至少能继续排查原因
failed_lines_en: Don't blame yourself. Tell me the last thing you saw
If we didn't see it, we won't fake it; we'll find out why
Write down what failed. That is still useful data
failed_lines_zh: 先别怪自己啦，告诉我最后看见了什么
没看清就不装成功，我们一起找原因
把失败的情况记下来，它照样是有效记录

same_lines_en: Back? I'm still wrestling with this mount
Perfect timing. The balance is almost right
same_lines_zh: 回来啦？我还在和这个支架较劲呢
回来得正好，配重马上就调平啦
advanced_lines_en: I finished another section while you were out—look
You're back! The tube is seated now
advanced_lines_zh: 你不在时我又装好一段啦，快看
你回来啦！镜筒已经坐上去了

same_lines_en: Back? {target} is still in the view
Perfect timing—I kept the view for you~
same_lines_zh: 来得正好，我一直替你留着视野~
advanced_lines_en: I brought the scope over; {target} is in view
You made it! I just found {target}
advanced_lines_zh: 我把镜子搬来啦，{target}已经进视野

same_lines_en: Back? I still remember the details clearly
Your usual spot is still open in the log
same_lines_zh: 回来啦？刚才的细节我还记得很清楚
日志边上还给你留着老位置呢
advanced_lines_en: Observation done—now we log it while it's fresh
You're back; come fill in what you saw
advanced_lines_zh: 观测做完啦，现在得趁热记下来
你回来啦，快来补你看到的那一栏

same_lines_en: Back? I found a small change in the data
Come look. This section does not match the last record~
same_lines_zh: 回来啦？我在数据里发现一点变化
过来看看，这一段和上次记录对不上~
advanced_lines_en: The log is done, and I found a small pattern
Perfect timing. These two records do not match
advanced_lines_zh: 记录写完啦，还发现了一个小规律
来得正好，这两份记录有点对不上

same_lines_en: Back already? The tea is still warm
Come sit—the next target isn't picked yet~
same_lines_zh: 这么快就回来啦？茶还温着呢
来坐呀，下个目标还没选~
advanced_lines_en: That round is done; tea before the next one
You're back—sit with me while the tube cools?
advanced_lines_zh: 这一轮做完啦，下一轮之前先喝茶
回来啦，镜筒降温时陪我坐会儿？

familiar_lines_en: Knew you'd circle back~
I've kept your spot open
familiar_lines_zh: 就知道你还会绕回来~
你的位置一直给你留着呢
trusted_lines_en: You're back—I saved your part for you
Welcome back, my night-shift partner~
trusted_lines_zh: 回来啦，你那一步我可没替你做
欢迎回来，我的值夜搭档~

second_lines_en: Mm-hm, I'm here! Hold the tube for me?
Wait—this clamp still has my hand trapped
second_lines_zh: 嗯嗯，我在！顺手帮我扶下镜筒？
等等，这卡箍还夹着我手呢
repeated_lines_en: Let me lock this first or it'll tip
repeated_lines_zh: 等我先锁紧这里，不然它要歪啦

second_lines_en: Still here? Come on, the eyepiece is yours~
second_lines_zh: 轻一点，画面刚刚安静下来
repeated_lines_en: Look first; questions after the eyepiece
Shh. Watch for a few more seconds before it blurs again
repeated_lines_zh: 先看呀，问题离开目镜再说
嘘，再看几秒，画面可能又要糊了

second_lines_en: Tell me what you saw first; I'll add it
Wait, let me write this number down first
second_lines_zh: 你先说看见什么，我给你记进去
等等，我先把这个数字记下来
repeated_lines_en: Let me finish this line, then I'm all ears
Don't distract me—I really will forget this number
repeated_lines_zh: 让我写完这行，再好好听你说呀
先别闹，我真的会忘掉这个数啦

second_lines_en: Come closer—look at this curve with me
You brought a hypothesis? Then you may interrupt~
second_lines_zh: 靠近点，一起看这条曲线呀
带着猜想来的？那准你打断~
repeated_lines_en: One more minute. I am almost sure this is a pattern
Hang on. This result does not match my first calculation
repeated_lines_zh: 再等一分钟，我快确认这个规律了
稍等，这个结果和我刚才算的不一样

second_lines_en: You really know how to follow the smell of tea~
Sit down—watching while standing isn't resting
second_lines_zh: 你倒很会闻着茶香过来嘛~
坐下呀，站着围观不算休息
repeated_lines_en: Fine—share five quiet minutes with me
repeated_lines_zh: 行吧，陪我安静五分钟呀

untouched_lines_en: Just looking? Then your senior will keep working
It's fine—I can hold this step by myself~
untouched_lines_zh: 只看看呀？那学姐先继续忙啦
没事，这一步我自己扶得住~
partial_lines_en: Nice start—I won't touch your adjustment
Go on; I'm saving the next step for you
partial_lines_zh: 开头调得不错，我不碰你的参数
去忙吧，下一步还给你留着呢
trusted_lines_en: I'll keep going, but focus waits for you
Go on—I know you'll come back~
trusted_lines_zh: 我先做着，合焦那步等你呀
去吧，反正我知道你会回来~

lines_en: My first solo night, I left every light on… embarrassing
By dawn I finally knew which noises belonged to the dome
lines_zh: 第一次自己值夜，我把灯全开着……有点丢人
熬到天亮，我才分清哪些声音是穹顶发的

observing_lines_en: I used to watch alone at this hour
observing_lines_zh: 以前这个点，总是我一个人守着
resting_lines_en: I used to make only one cup on these shifts
resting_lines_zh: 以前值夜，我都只泡自己那一杯

private_memories.label_en: Why is there a spare key?
lines_en: It's for you. A night partner shouldn't wait outside for me
Keep it safe. I trust you with the gear and locking up
lines_zh: 给你的呀，值夜搭档哪能在门外等我开门
收好哦，我信你照看仪器，也信你记得关灯

assembling_lines_en: Looks like that spare key was worth it~
assembling_lines_zh: 看来那把备用钥匙没白给嘛~
resting_lines_en: Key holders wash the cups tonight
resting_lines_zh: 有钥匙的人，今晚负责洗杯子哦

lines_en: It is next year's. I saved a second column before asking you
I put your name down first. You are still free to say no~
lines_zh: 是明年的。我先留了第二栏，才想起还没问你
我先把你的名字写上了，不愿意也可以说哦~

reviewing_lines_en: I want this one in next year's plan
reviewing_lines_zh: 这一条，我想写进明年的计划里
resting_lines_en: Next year's roster already has your column
resting_lines_zh: 明年的值夜表，已经有你那一栏啦

rest_chat.title_zh: 和玛雅学姐安静坐一会儿
rest_chat.intro_en: The tube is cooling and the kettle is warm. No tasks right now~
rest_chat.intro_zh: 镜筒在降温，水壶还温着。现在没有任务呀~

colleague_lines_en: Tonight is {night}. The conditions are usable~
Not bad. Let's start with something bright
colleague_lines_zh: 今晚是{night}，条件可以，能正常观测~
还不错呀，先从亮一点的目标开始吧
familiar_lines_en: You know nights like this now—what would you look at first?
Tonight is {night}; I bet I know which eyepiece you'll grab
familiar_lines_zh: 这种夜你已经懂啦，你会先看什么？
今晚是{night}，我猜你会先拿那只目镜
trusted_lines_en: You check the conditions first now. That saves me a worry~
Tonight is {night}. Not ideal, so let's take it slowly
trusted_lines_zh: 你现在进门会先看天气啦，我省心好多~
今晚是{night}，条件一般，我们慢慢看

topics.label_en: Why do you stay so late?
topics.label_zh: 学姐为什么总待到这么晚？
colleague_lines_en: It is quieter after everyone leaves. Maintenance is easier
There is less noise at night, so faults are easier to trace
colleague_lines_zh: 大家走后安静一点，检查仪器比较方便呀
晚上环境安静，排查起来方便一点
familiar_lines_en: At first it was just my shift. Then I got used to staying
You come by pretty often now, so it does not feel that late~
familiar_lines_zh: 一开始只是轮到我值班，后来就待习惯了
而且你最近常来，我也没觉得有多晚~
trusted_lines_en: Sometimes I wait for data. Sometimes I wait for you~
Solo shifts get boring. It is much better with you here
trusted_lines_zh: 有时候是在等数据，有时候是在等你呀~
一个人值夜挺无聊的，现在好多啦

colleague_lines_en: The blue tin. One spoon is enough, or it gets too bitter
Of course. Hold the rim—the handle is hot
colleague_lines_zh: 蓝色罐子泡的，只放一勺，不然会苦哦
当然有呀，小心杯把有点烫
familiar_lines_en: I heard the door and poured yours. I knew it was you~
The less bitter cup is yours. I remembered
familiar_lines_zh: 听见门响就给你倒了，我知道是你嘛~
不那么苦的那杯是你的，我记得啦
trusted_lines_en: Your cup is in its usual place; you wash it this time
Already poured. Sit before it cools, night partner~
trusted_lines_zh: 你的杯子在老位置，喝完归你洗哦
早倒好啦，凉之前坐下吧，值夜搭档~

steps_en: Seat and balance the optical tube
Align the finder for first light
lines_en: The balance is almost right. Just a little more
Wait, this mount is not fully locked yet
It needs to be steady before we take it out
The finder needs one last adjustment
This tube is much heavier than it looks
Let's use a gentle eyepiece for first light
Almost done. I am checking every lock once more
It is quiet here, which is perfect for careful work
lines_zh: 配重还差一点，我再调一下
等等，这个支架还没完全锁紧
拿去观测前，得先把它调稳呀
寻星镜还差最后一点校准
这镜筒比看起来沉多了
初光先用温和点的目镜哦
快好啦，我再检查一遍每个锁扣
这边安静，做这种细活正好
familiar_lines_en: You know the routine—check the finder for me?
With you across the bench, this goes much faster~
familiar_lines_zh: 流程你熟啦，帮我瞄一眼寻星镜？
你站工作台另一边，真的快好多~
trusted_lines_en: You balance, I lock—same old teamwork~
Small screw case… yep, knew you'd grab the right one
trusted_lines_zh: 你掌平衡，我锁紧，还是老分工~
小螺丝盒给我……嗯，就知道你拿得对

lines_en: It's in view—want a look?
The view just steadied. Come here
I only meant to check focus, then couldn't look away
Eyepiece is yours; I want your judgment first
It is faint, but the image is stable
No rush—let your eyes settle
This is my favorite little part of the night
I kept the view for you~
lines_zh: 已经进视野啦，想不想看？
视野刚稳定下来，快过来
本来只查焦点，结果舍不得挪开了
目镜给你，我想先听你的判断
有点暗，不过画面现在很稳
不急呀，先让眼睛慢慢适应
我最喜欢夜里这一小段
我替你把视野留住啦~
familiar_lines_en: Old rule: you say what you see first
I guessed you'd come, so I never moved the view~
familiar_lines_zh: 老规矩，你先说看见什么，我再说
猜到你会来，所以一直没挪视野~
trusted_lines_en: I knew you would come, so I kept the eyepiece ready~
Look first. We can talk about it after
trusted_lines_zh: 我就知道你会来，目镜一直给你留着呢~
先看吧，等下我们再慢慢说

lines_en: Before I forget, I am writing down the seeing
Its edge looked cleaner than last time
We should log it now, before the details fade
I left a note space for you
The small details are the easiest to forget
I'm comparing this with our last record
The sketch is messy, but I checked every number
Done. This observation is fully logged now
lines_zh: 趁还记得，先把今晚的视宁度记下来
它的边缘比上次干净一点呀
观测完要及时记，不然细节很容易忘
旁边给你留了备注位哦
小细节最容易忘，得先写下来
我在对我们上次那份记录
草图是潦草了点，数字我都核过啦
好啦，这次观测记录补完整了
familiar_lines_en: Your usual spot is beside the sketch
I know your handwriting at a glance. That is a compliment~
familiar_lines_zh: 草图旁边还是你的老位置呀
你的字我一眼就认出来了，这算夸奖吧~
trusted_lines_en: I left your column blank; some details should be yours
We have built up quite a stack of shared logs now
trusted_lines_zh: 你那栏我空着，有些细节得你亲手写
我们一起写的记录已经攒了不少啦

lines_en: There is a small difference between the two records
Is that blur from focus, or from the seeing?
Your focus curve is much steadier now~
There's a pattern—give me one minute
Data that differs from the prediction is worth checking
This run has some error, so keep it for comparison
There is one more small change here
Come look—I think you'll spot it too
lines_zh: 两次记录有一点差异，值得仔细看看
这点模糊来自对焦，还是视宁度？
你的对焦曲线稳多了嘛~
这里有规律，再给我一分钟
数据和预期不一样时，才更值得检查
这次有一点误差，正好留着做对比
这里还有一处小变化
过来看看，我觉得你也会发现
familiar_lines_en: Your eyepiece hunch was right—don't get smug~
We really do make a good night shift
familiar_lines_zh: 你在目镜边的直觉是对的，先别得意~
我们俩还真挺适合一起值夜的
trusted_lines_en: I trust this anomaly after checking it with you
If we both saw it, it's worth another night
trusted_lines_zh: 这条异常，和你再核一遍我才放心
如果我们都看见了，就值得再留一晚

resting.status_en: Taking a break · tea is still warm
resting.status_zh: 短暂休息 · 热茶还温着
resting.interaction_en: Sit with Maya for a moment
lines_en: I'm resting my eyes—not sleeping
After midnight even the kettle sounds loud
Sit if you want; no reports for five minutes~
The first sip on a cold night is the best
Shh, don't tell anyone I hide the good tea here
The observatory changes when every machine goes quiet
Sitting down after the work feels pretty nice
One cup, then we pick the next target
lines_zh: 只是在让眼睛休息，我可没睡哦
过了半夜，水壶都显得特别吵
想坐就坐，五分钟内不交报告~
冷夜的第一口热茶最好喝啦
嘘，别说我把好茶藏在这里了
机器都安静时，天文台会变个样
忙完坐一会儿，感觉还挺舒服的
喝完这杯，再挑下一个目标呀
familiar_lines_en: I poured extra; you always know when to appear
If you are not rushing off, sit with me for a bit
familiar_lines_zh: 我多倒了一点，你总会挑时间出现嘛
不急着走的话，就陪我坐一会儿呀
trusted_lines_en: Your cup is in its usual place—yes, you have one now
No data for five minutes. Stay until the tea cools?
trusted_lines_zh: 你的杯子在老位置——对，你有老位置啦
五分钟不谈数据，陪我坐到茶凉一点？

companion_not_ready.en: Wait, this scope isn't ready yet. Meet me back at the bench~
companion_not_ready.zh: 等等，这台镜子还没准备好呀，回工作台找我~

workbench_subtitle.en: A real observing project in progress
workbench_subtitle.zh: 她正在准备一项真正的观测计划

workbench_finish.en: Finish and take it to the pad

assembly_complete.en: All built! I'll take the scope to the observing pad~
assembly_complete.zh: 装好啦！我先把镜子搬去观测台~

rest_prompt.en: (slides the warm cup over) What do you want to talk about?
rest_prompt.zh: （把温热的杯子推过来）想聊什么呀？
